about: Settings page names that are gone (T12.5b) and the ways shown text names a page. The UI guard (packages/ui/src/settings/pageNames.test.ts) and the desktop guard (apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/page_names_tests.rs) both take the pages and forms from here and run every case; a rule change edits this file. {page} stands for a gone page; a form matches as whole words (no letter, digit or underscore right after it).
